scripts.typecheck: yarn workspaces foreach -A --exclude omega run typecheck
scripts.lint: yarn workspaces foreach -A --exclude omega run lint
scripts.test: yarn workspaces foreach -A --exclude omega run test
scripts.build: yarn workspaces foreach -A --exclude omega run build
scripts.format:check: prettier --check package.json .yarnrc.yml tsconfig.json eslint.config.js apps packages
scripts.format: prettier --write package.json .yarnrc.yml tsconfig.json eslint.config.js apps packages
